My father passed away 4 years ago. He was 81 and had been sick for a while, so It wasn't a surprise and I had time to adjust to it beforehand. I made sure there was nothing left unsaid between us. We had a very good relationship, so I was fortunate in that there was nothing between us that needed to be resolved. 4 years later I still catch myself about to call him. I dream about him frequently, but it never makes me wake up sad or feeling a loss. I sort of just have the feeling that we had a conversation or hung out.

There's no getting around the fact that losing a parent sucks. You are allowed to feel how you feel about it. Those feelings are going to swing wildly and that is ok too. My advice is to just be aware of the stages of grief and if you catch yourself in one stage too long (except acceptance), consider grief counseling. If you have time with your mom, even if it is only a few hours, have a conversation with her. don't leave anything unsaid. Regret is harder to live with than grief.
